title: Lectionary Sources
description: The bishops' conference websites that publish the readings of the day (#1074), keyed by a short source id. For each: its URL patterns, the range of dates it publishes, the national calendars it follows, and the page leftovers that cannot be computed from the date. /calendar uses them to give an event a readings_source_url.

day_page.description: The URL of a day's page, with the placeholders {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM} and {DD} filled from the event's date.

linked_page.description: The URL of a page listed in pages, with {page} replaced by the listed value; the date placeholders are filled as in day_page.

first_date.description: The first date the site publishes readings for (inclusive).

last_date.description: The last date the site publishes readings for (inclusive). Moves forward as the site publishes ahead; see scripts/probe-lectionary-sources.php.

calendars.description: The national calendars whose events (and whose dioceses' events) link to this source.

pages.description: Leftovers by event_key: an event whose readings are not on the day page itself (a USCCB memorial page) or are one section of it (a CEI section id). A value keyed by weekday cycle (I, II) or by Sunday cycle (A, B, C), never both, applies only in that cycle. {day} in a value stands for the MMDDYY of the event's date (the next day for a vigil Mass).
